groups.group_name: Privileged User Credentials Exposed on Defender XDR Endpoints
groups.rationale: This check identifies critical security incidents where privileged user credentials have been exposed on endpoints monitored by Microsoft Defender XDR.

groups.group_name: Administrative Users Maintain Minimal Licensing Footprint
groups.rationale: This check ensures administrative users are assigned only necessary licenses to reduce attack surface and licensing costs. This represents a unique control focused on resource optimization and attack surface reduction.

groups.group_name: Entra Admin Users Require Enhanced Authentication Controls
groups.rationale: Both checks verify that administrator accounts have enhanced authentication requirements through Conditional Access policies targeting admin roles specifically.

groups.group_name: Entra Conditional Access Policies Enforce Security Controls
groups.rationale: All these checks validate that Entra ID Conditional Access policies are properly configured to enforce various security controls including device compliance, authentication requirements, risk-based access controls, and identity protection. They share the same remediation approach of configuring or enabling specific Conditional Access policy settings within the Entra ID portal and represent a comprehensive set of policy-based security controls managed through the same service interface.

groups.group_name: Entra Default Policy Restricts Non-Admin User Privileges
groups.rationale: These checks all enforce the principle of least privilege by restricting default user capabilities through Entra ID authorization and user settings policies.

groups.group_name: Entra Emergency Access Account Configuration and Protection
groups.rationale: This check validates that emergency access accounts are properly excluded from Conditional Access policies to prevent administrative lockout scenarios.

groups.group_name: Entra Users Enrolled in Multi-Factor Authentication
groups.rationale: This check validates that users have registered for and are capable of performing multi-factor authentication. This is a user-level enrollment status check.

groups.group_name: Microsoft 365 Groups Configured with Private Visibility
groups.rationale: This check validates that Microsoft 365 groups are not configured with public visibility, which would expose group membership and content to unauthorized users.

groups.group_name: Defender XDR Critical Asset Classifications Approved
groups.rationale: This check validates that critical asset classifications within Microsoft Defender XDR have been reviewed and approved rather than remaining in pending status.

groups.group_name: Defender for Identity Service Health Monitoring
groups.rationale: This check validates that Microsoft Defender for Identity has no unresolved health issues that could impact hybrid infrastructure monitoring capabilities.

groups.group_name: Entra Admin Portal Access Restricted to Administrative Roles
groups.rationale: This check validates that administrative portals are only accessible to users with administrative roles, preventing regular users from accessing sensitive configuration interfaces.

groups.group_name: Entra App Registration Has No Unused Privileged API Permissions
groups.rationale: This check ensures application registrations do not retain excessive or unused privileged API permissions that could be exploited if the application is compromised.

groups.group_name: Entra Application Credential Management Policy Configured
groups.rationale: This check validates that the tenant enforces credential restrictions on applications and service principals through the default app management policy.

groups.group_name: Entra Password Hash Synchronization Enabled for Hybrid Identity
groups.rationale: This check validates that password hash synchronization is enabled for hybrid identity deployments to ensure authentication resilience and enable cloud-based authentication capabilities.

groups.group_name: Entra Guest User Management Through Dynamic Groups
groups.rationale: This check validates the existence of a dynamic membership group for guest users to enable centralized guest user management and policy application.
